assigned_to: Grok (SuperGrok, Grok Imagine video) FIRST. If Grok is out of credits, any other video AI (e.g. Gemini Veo) may continue with the clips still missing.
supersedes: artreq_20261001-2230_splash-film-v4 (do NOT make v4; v5 replaces it)
owner_feedback: The owner wants better, more elaborate and over-the-top splash films than the five live ones (v3, rated 6/10: great energy but they felt like placeholders and did not flow into the app). Go bigger: more spectacle, more detail, more colour, more motion, more sound. Every clip must end with THE LANDING so the app can zoom straight out of the last frame.
how_to_prompt: Video models follow short, concrete, time-coded direction better than long adjective lists. For each clip, send your model the clip's `beats` as written (they are already time-coded), plus `look` and `the_landing`. Keep every beat a single continuous camera move: no cuts unless a beat says CUT. Generate with sound ON.
instructions: Follow 'Titan Reliquary/ART_START_HERE (any AI: images + video)', including the CLAIM step (write artreq_20261005-0900_splash-film-v5-overthetop.CLAIMED-grok.txt in art-requests (any AI: images + video)/ first). Make the clips in `clips` IN ORDER (ranked by priority); make 2 takes of each of the first three if credits allow (file names _take1/_take2 before .mp4). If credits run out, stop and list the rest as 'skipped: credits' in the DONE file. Save each at full native quality to Titan Reliquary/art-incoming (AI images + video)/artreq_20261005-0900_splash-film-v5-overthetop/ with the exact file_name. ONE file per clip, WITH sound; no _silent copies. Then write artreq_20261005-0900_splash-film-v5-overthetop.DONE.txt in art-requests (any AI: images + video)/ listing every file you made.

deliverable_spec.resolution: highest your tool offers: 4K if available (Veo/Flow upscale is fine), else 1080p; never 720p if 1080p is offered.
deliverable_spec.duration: 15 s (Grok Imagine maximum). If your model's maximum is shorter, compress the beats proportionally and keep THE LANDING as the last ~2 s.
deliverable_spec.audio: REQUIRED, one mixed track: cinematic, punchy, synced to the beats (listed per clip). No voices, no lyrics, no existing music.

look: The most spectacular movie-trailer opening possible, never a screensaver: hyper-detailed photoreal CGI at the level of a big-budget sci-fi film (transforming machines with thousands of moving parts, real physics, heavy motion blur on fast moves, volumetric light, sparks and debris that bounce and scatter, true reflections in polished silver and gold), mixed with psychedelic infinite-zoom colour (fractals, kaleidoscopes, neon portals). The camera is always moving and always pushing FORWARD. Strong contrast, rich colour, one clear subject at a time. Silver and gold coins are the hero everywhere. Original designs only: no existing robots, characters, logos or brands; no text, numbers or legible inscriptions; no people or faces. Push every shot further than feels reasonable: more particles, more layers of motion, bigger scale, richer colour, faster camera.
the_landing: THE LANDING (the last 2 seconds of EVERY clip, required): the camera rushes straight forward into the exact centre of the frame, faster and faster, as if diving through it. Everything stretches into radial light streaks (warp-speed zoom blur) and the centre blooms into a soft, smooth, bright glow that fills the whole frame by the final frame (the final frame is almost a plain bright soft glow with no detail). Sound: a rising whoosh into one deep cinematic impact on the very last frame, with a shimmering ring tail. Do NOT fade to black and do NOT cut away: the app takes over by continuing the same forward zoom.
opening: Every clip starts instantly on its first beat (no fade-in from black, no slow establishing shot).
negative: no text, letters, numbers or logos; no people, faces or hands; no existing characters, robots, brands or franchises; no fade to black; no slow static shots; no cheap-looking plastic CGI; no warped or melting coins (coins stay crisp and round unless a beat says they transform).

clips.title: The Coinverse Opens
clips.beats: 0-2 s: black screen cracks open like glass; blinding gold light pours through the cracks. 2-6 s: the camera bursts through into an infinite cathedral built entirely of stacked silver and gold coins, kilometres tall, columns spinning, coins cascading like waterfalls on every side, god-rays through stained-glass windows made of translucent coins. 6-10 s: the whole cathedral folds in on itself like a kaleidoscope, the camera racing through a tunnel of rotating coin-mandalas cycling through every colour of the rainbow, fireworks detonating in sync with the music. 10-13 s: a single gigantic glowing silver coin rises ahead, its rim throwing off lightning. 13-15 s: The last 2 s are THE LANDING (see the_landing).
clips.sound: glass shattering, a choir-like synth swell, coin-waterfall roar, firework bursts on the beat, crackling lightning, then THE LANDING whoosh and impact.

clips.title: Titan Forge
clips.beats: 0-3 s: a colossal mechanical titan made of thousands of interlocking silver coins and gold bars rips itself out of a molten lake, lava and coins streaming off it. 3-7 s: it smashes its fists together; a shockwave of sparks, molten gold and spinning coins blasts toward the camera in slow motion, then snaps to full speed. 7-11 s: the camera whips around its head as its chest opens, gears and pistons unfolding layer after layer, revealing a blazing vault-door core. 11-13 s: the core starts to spin and glow white-hot. 13-15 s: The last 2 s are THE LANDING (see the_landing).
clips.sound: lava roar, deep servo groans, a massive bass SLAM on the fist impact, metal shrapnel and coin rain, rising engine whine, then THE LANDING.

clips.title: Dragon Hoard
clips.beats: 0-3 s: a mountain of gold and silver coins in a dark cavern starts to tremble; coins avalanche downward. 3-7 s: a gigantic dragon made of living gold coins bursts out of the hoard, every scale a coin, wings unfolding with a storm of coins flying off them. 7-11 s: it breathes a torrent of rainbow fire that turns into fireworks and spiralling coins; the camera flies alongside it through the cavern roof into a sky of exploding auroras. 11-13 s: the dragon curls into a ring around a blazing sun. 13-15 s: The last 2 s are THE LANDING (see the_landing).
clips.sound: coin avalanche, a thunderous roar, wing beats, a huge fire whoosh that turns into firework crackle, aurora shimmer, then THE LANDING.

clips.title: Infinite Mint
clips.beats: 0-3 s: extreme macro on the rim of a silver coin; the reeded edge becomes a canyon the camera dives into. 3-8 s: an endless psychedelic fractal zoom: coins inside coins inside coins, each layer a different metal and colour (silver, gold, rose gold, neon magenta, electric cyan), mandalas blooming and rotating, nothing ever repeats. 8-12 s: the fractal ignites into a supernova of fireworks and lightning, colours strobing in time with the music. 12-13 s: everything spirals into a single brilliant point. 13-15 s: The last 2 s are THE LANDING (see the_landing).
clips.sound: a metallic ring, a deep evolving synth drone that accelerates, glitter chimes, a huge drop at 8 s with firework crackle, then THE LANDING.

clips.title: Gold Rush Warp
clips.beats: 0-3 s: a sleek silver starship shaped like a stack of coins is launched out of a gigantic vault door in space, sparks and coins exploding off the door. 3-7 s: it races through an asteroid field made of tumbling gold bars and coins, near-misses, explosions on both sides. 7-11 s: it jumps to hyperspace: stars stretch into rainbow warp streaks, the ship splits into a thousand coins that become the streaks. 11-13 s: the streaks swirl into a glowing portal. 13-15 s: The last 2 s are THE LANDING (see the_landing).
clips.sound: vault-door boom, engine roar with doppler fly-bys, explosions, a hyperspace BOOM and shimmering riser, then THE LANDING.
